title: Look around the file system
description:
Write `std::size_t countByExtension(const std::filesystem::path& folder, std::string_view extension)` that counts the regular files directly inside `folder` whose extension equals `extension` (given with its dot, for example `".txt"`). Sub-folders are not searched. A folder that does not exist counts as 0.

`std::filesystem::directory_iterator` visits each entry; an entry has `is_regular_file()` and `path()`, and a path has `extension()`.
hints: `for (const auto& entry : std::filesystem::directory_iterator{ folder })` and count the entries where `entry.is_regular_file() && entry.path().extension() == extension`.
